[[File:Protato.png|thumb|right|250px|Protato]]
The '''protato''', not to be confused with a [[Potato/Legends|potato]], was an orange type of protein-enhanced synthetic vegetable. [[Anakin Solo]] threw globs of it at his brother [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] when their [[Solo family/Legends|family]] would sit down to eat meals. It also featured as an ingredient on several of the dishes cooked by [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] chef [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], including [[protato wedge]]s and [["Besalisk's Bellyful" hash]].
